name: cyclopts-validator-aware-shell-completion
instr:
Cyclopts completion should stop suggesting argument combinations that existing Group validators will reject. Callers should be able to inspect the same completion decisions before producing a shell program and choose how unsupported validator shapes are handled. Existing runtime validation and unconstrained completion behavior must remain intact.

LimitedChoice and MutuallyExclusive semantics compile into the same bounded selections accepted at runtime, including optional all-or-none relationships, unless CompletionGroupPolicy.DISABLED is selected; invalid policies raise ValueError during Group construction. Canonical member identity spans aliases, negative Boolean spellings, nested scopes, and resolved lazy commands. Analysis exposes immutable constraints, observed state, decisions with stable reasons, and diagnostics in deterministic command-path and declaration order. Bash, Zsh, and Fish suppress exactly the validator-forbidden options while preserving each shell's prefix, path, description, nested-dispatch, positional, and rest-argument behavior. Token interpretation is consistent for option values, equals assignments, repeatable members, aliases, and double dash. CompletionConstraintMode.IGNORE silently preserves unconstrained behavior, CompletionConstraintMode.WARN emits one deterministic warning per unsupported constraint, and CompletionConstraintMode.ERROR raises CompletionConstraintError before producing output; CompletionGroupPolicy has AUTO='auto' and DISABLED='dis
